name: us030-env-file-inert
description: 030 US1 AC3: a .env holding a token is present in .specify/jira/ and ignored entirely — the bridge no longer reads that file. Neither JIRA_API_TOKEN nor JIRA_PAT_COMMAND is set, so resolution fails exactly as it would with no .env at all — exit 3 (auth), empty call log. Byte-identical across ports proves neither port's reader opened the file.
